cards.one_row: One item line on one receipt
cards.made: Each till writes it. Each store sends a file every night
cards.why: Money. Refunds. Goods sold by weight. A store's file can be late, missing or sent twice
cards.state: **State after milestone 1:** questions 1 to 5 are answered. Questions 6 to 8 need the checks, and those are written in milestone 2.

blocks.text: One item line on one receipt. A receipt with three products has three rows.
The true key of a row is `receipt_id` + `line_no`. The column `line_id` is not a true key: the export program makes a new one every time it writes a file.

questions.question: What must be prepared before it can be checked?
questions.title: What must be prepared before it can be checked?

head: Worry
What must be prepared first
rows: A whole day missing or doubled
Count the rows per store per day, and compare with a normal day for that store
Wrong sign or wrong size
Add the lines up per till per day, and hold the total against `till_totals`
The same sale twice
Group by `receipt_id` + `line_no`, not by `line_id`
A sale on the wrong day
Join to `stores` for the opening hours
A line the join drops
Compare the raw rows with the clean rows

blocks.text: Four of the five need a join, a total or a comparison first. None of them is a one-line check.

cards.one_row: One till's own total for one day
cards.made: The till adds it up when it is closed

cards.why: Tiny. Wrong here is wrong everywhere

cards.one_row: One product in one store on one day
cards.made: Counted by hand or by scanner
cards.why: A count of one moment. A missing day is a gap, not a zero

cards.one_row: One product's cost from one supplier
